g.text: Vina Bim Shop Detailed Data Platform Architecture
Data lifecycle view: source contracts -> ingestion -> Bronze -> realtime + batch -> serving -> governance evidence
Spark + Iceberg + Trino Gold is official
DuckDB mart is a Trino Gold snapshot.
Primary business data or query serving
through Trino Gold for offline review
Scenario data, synthetic metric events, business envelopes
Product cards represent deployed Compose service groups.
- Pinot includes Zookeeper, controller, broker, and server;
- DataHub includes GMS, frontend, actions, Elasticsearch,
